readerCopy.body: A refusal can become easier to act on before it has been explained enough to satisfy everyone who might dislike it. When Mars trines Lilith, action and autonomy reinforce each other, making a boundary, preference, or less approved decision easier to put into practice. Defiance can protect something meaningful without needing opposition itself to become the purpose. The strongest action creates room for the actual choice rather than keeping the conflict alive for its own sake.
